item.title: The Nobel Prize and the Laureate Are Inseparable
item.description:
📝 A Nobel Peace Prize can also never be revoked. Christian Lous Lange (Peace Prize 1921): The medal of Norway’s first Nobel Peace Prize laureate has been on long-term loan from the Lange family to the Nobel Peace Center in Oslo since 2005. This is the highest price ever paid for a Nobel Prize medal.

item.title: Gaussian Splatting – A$AP Rocky Helicopter Music Video
item.description:
📝 Chris told me he’d been tracking volumetric performance capture for years, fascinated by emerging techniques that could enable visuals that simply weren’t possible before. It’s a workflow that more closely resembles simulation than traditional filming. Chris also discovered that Octane’s Houdini integration had matured, and that Octane’s early splat support was far enough along to enable relighting.
🔗 Read more: https://radiancefields.com/a-ap-rocky-releases-helicopter-music-video-featuring-gaussian-splatting

item.title: How the Lobsters front page works
item.description:
📝 OrderThe value of \( \textbf{order} \) is derived from the engagement that a story gets. This was mostly vibecoded, with me verifying that the results match the algorithm. Over time, age always dominates upvotes, so no story can really stick around that long in the front page.
🔗 Read more: https://atharvaraykar.com/lobsters/

item.title: A Social Filesystem
item.description:
📝 Apps create and read your files on your behalf, but files don’t belong to the apps. To do that reliably, apps need your files to be structured. In this paradigm, apps are reactive to files.
🔗 Read more: https://overreacted.io/a-social-filesystem/

item.description:
